name: sbom_check
description: Check a software bill of materials in CycloneDX JSON (1.4, 1.5, 1.6) or SPDX JSON (2.2, 2.3): the fields each specification requires, components without a version, purl or licence, duplicate components, bom-refs and SPDXIDs, dangling dependency and relationship references, the NTIA minimum elements, and a licence summary with SPDX ids counted and checked against the bundled SPDX License List (deprecated and unknown ids), NOASSERTION, NONE, LicenseRef- and expressions.

sbom.description: The SBOM as a JSON object

sbom_text.description: Or the SBOM as JSON text

path.description: Or a relative path to the JSON file

max_list.description: Longest list of component names per category

catalog.source: CycloneDX specification 1.4-1.6 (ECMA-424) JSON schemas; SPDX specification 2.2 and 2.3 (ISO/IEC 5962:2021 for 2.2.1) clauses 6-11 and Annex D; NTIA minimum elements (2021); SPDX License List 3.29.0 bundled by tools/catalog/data/sbom_check.py
